name: Overworked!
source:
"Overworked!" follows Hoss, a horse moving to the big city of Foxdale. A city known for opportunity, love, and  ̶d̶e̶m̶o̶n̶s̶. After losing his funds in a phishing accident, A job search leads him to Kenji Handy, a local handyman business. Join Hoss as he meets new friends, foes, and uncovers the mystery of his missing bank account!

[From [url=https://bearhut-studios.itch.io/overworked]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“劳累过度了！”跟随霍斯，一匹马前往大城市福克斯代尔。一座以机会、爱和 ̶d̶e̶m̶o̶n̶s̶ 闻名的城市。在一次网络钓鱼事故中失去资金后，他在寻找工作时找到了当地一家杂工公司Kenji Handy。和霍斯一起结识新朋友、新敌人，并揭开他失踪的银行账户之谜！

[来自[url=https://bearhut-studios.itch.io/overworked]Itch.io[/url]]
